Durations are wall-clock spans, not CPU/RAM use. Exit -1 is unknown/unfinished, not a proven failure. History does not establish human authorship or capture GUI activity/all agent tool calls. Saved duration order statistic is the upper median (not the mean of the middle pair for even samples).
